method: Actual local browser UI through mcp__cua_repl, Playwright locators and read-only DOM observations
browserFallback: The requested iab creation returned Browser is not available; a new dedicated Chrome session was used without touching existing tabs or native OS UI.
loadHandling: Each full page navigation/reload waited for load before deep interactions.
scope: 13 representative account/studio screen flows. The root's complete state/width rendering scan is a separate verification.
restrictionsObserved: Only local prototype forms and in-memory examples were changed.
No real account, OAuth, permission, device session, capture, encoder or network setting was changed.
No browser permission prompt or OS action was used.
No viewport override, metrics reset, deliverable mark or handoff mark was used.
